categories.main_business_segments: Hubei Chaozhuo Aviation Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in customized additive manufacturing and airborne equipment maintenance. Its main business includes additive manufacturing of aerospace parts and consumables, manufacturing of precision sheet and strip forming equipment and parts, and additive manufacturing of new energy vehicle parts. The company also provides maintenance services for airborne equipment and produces sputtering target materials for electronics and semiconductor industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in cold spray solid-state additive manufacturing technology, which involves accelerating powder particles to supersonic speeds and depositing them in solid form to repair or manufacture parts. This technology features low thermal input, high deposition efficiency, and superior material properties, enabling in-situ repair of aircraft structural components without thermal damage. The company has developed proprietary low-pressure and high-pressure cold spray technologies, mobile additive manufacturing platforms, fatigue damage automated repair techniques, and advanced coating technologies such as ultra-hard tungsten carbide coatings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include a major domestic aerospace client and its affiliated aircraft overhaul factories, aviation industrial groups, major domestic airlines such as China Southern Airlines and Air China, steel and metallurgical enterprises, and automotive parts manufacturers. The company serves aerospace, new energy vehicles, industrial machine tools, and electronics industries, with products applied in aircraft structural repair, new energy vehicle thermal management components, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters in Xiangyang, Hubei Province, and subsidiaries in Shanghai, Luoyang, Chengdu, and Zhangjiagang. Its market coverage includes domestic aerospace overhaul bases, automotive manufacturing hubs, and industrial regions across China. There is no significant overseas operational presence reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hubei Chaozhuo Aviation Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It focuses on additive manufacturing and repair services for aerospace structural components and parts manufacturing for new energy vehicles and industrial equipment. The company procures raw materials such as metal powders and industrial gases, mainly from overseas suppliers, and delivers finished products and maintenance services directly to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in cold spray solid-state additive manufacturing technology, expanding applications in aerospace, new energy vehicles, industrial machinery, and electronics. R&D efforts focus on developing integrated additive and subtractive manufacturing equipment, optimizing gas recovery systems, enhancing powder deposition efficiency, and advancing coating materials. The company maintains a strong patent portfolio and collaborates with academic and research institutions to sustain technological leadership and expand industrial applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized additive manufacturing products, manufacturing of precision equipment and parts, and provision of maintenance services for airborne equipment. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model, with contracts and orders based on customer specifications and acceptance. It also earns income from leasing investment properties and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few domestic enterprises mastering cold spray solid-state additive manufacturing technology and is the sole supplier for fatigue crack repair of aircraft landing gear beams at major domestic overhaul bases. It holds a leading position in the domestic aerospace additive manufacturing and maintenance market, with recognized technological advantages and strong customer relationships. Competitors include other aerospace maintenance providers and additive manufacturing firms, but the company's proprietary technology and certifications provide a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 403.58 million, representing a 49.38% increase year-over-year. It returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 12.99 million, reversing a prior loss. Total assets were about RMB 1.6 billion, with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company maintains steady growth driven by expanded business scope and increased market penetration in additive manufacturing and new energy vehicle parts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced cold spray solid-state additive manufacturing technology, which enables low-temperature, high-strength, and defect-free repair and manufacturing of complex aerospace and industrial components. Its technology allows in-situ repair of critical aircraft structural parts without thermal damage, extending service life and improving safety. The company also highlights its comprehensive quality management, strong R&D capabilities, and exclusive supplier status for key aerospace maintenance projects, delivering customized, high-performance products and services that meet stringent industry standards.
